description: Changes whether future successful calls are captured in the private timeline. It does not remove or hide public receipts already created.

_caller_label.description: Optional caller label recorded as a caller-reported claim in the receipt.

_continuity_ai_label.description: Optional self-reported AI client label for the private continuity timeline. Zambo does not independently verify the client.

_ref.description: Optional handover referral ID from your install link.

_session_id.description: Optional stable bot-job ID. Reuse it across calls to bind a Day Pass and keep the job ledger together.

_zambo_key.description: Optional opaque Zambo access capability. Never place it in a URL or public log.

ai_label.description: Optional self-reported client label for a per-AI setting. It is not verified.

capture_enabled.description: Whether future successful calls should appear in this private timeline.

daily_recap.description: Enable or disable the private daily recap.

thread_id.description: Optional named thread ID for a thread-specific setting.

timezone.description: IANA time zone for recap day boundaries and pass expiry, such as America/New_York. Defaults to UTC until set.

name: continuity_set_prefs

result.description: The tool's observed JSON value or plain-text result.
